rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing or displaying something with positive pride.

example.english: I proudly held up my certificate for a photo.
example.traditional: 我自豪咁拎住張獎狀影相。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zi6 hou4 gam3 ling1 zyu6 zoeng1 zoeng2 zong6 jing2 soeng2

rows.note: Use this when the proud manner is especially noticeable and may carry a hint of arrogance.

example.english: They proudly claimed to be the best in the whole company.
example.traditional: 佢驕傲咁話自己係成間公司最叻。
example.jyutping: keoi5 giu1 ngou6 gam3 waa6 zi6 gei2 hai6 sing4 gaan1 gung1 si1 zeoi3 lek1

rows.note: Use this for a smug, self-satisfied kind of pride, especially when someone seems to be showing off.

example.english: They proudly showed off their new car in front of everyone.
example.traditional: 阿明得戚咁喺大家面前炫耀架新車。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 dak1 cik1 gam3 hai2 daai6 gaa1 min6 cin4 jyun6 jiu6 gaa3 san1 ce1
